title: Study domain and event-oriented monitoring design

data_files.purpose: Panel a: one coordinate per US study lake; use actual point positions.
data_files.format: UTF-8 CSV; header; decimal point; no row index

lake_id.meaning: Opaque lake identifier; preserve as a string. Not a plotted numerical variable.

longitude_deg.meaning: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees; western US values are negative.

data_files.purpose: Panel b: all 78 observed 2016–2018 fortnightly monitoring rounds.
data_files.format: UTF-8 CSV; header; decimal point; no row index

decision_date.meaning: Fortnightly decision date YYYY-MM-DD, in the 2016–2018 observed-workload series.

eligible_lakes.meaning: Number of eligible lakes at this decision round.

sampled_lakes.meaning: Eligible lakes sampled in this decision interval, each counted once per interval.

lake_sample_days.meaning: Number of lake sample days in this decision interval; different from sampled_lakes.

sampled_fraction_pct.meaning: 100 × sampled_lakes / eligible_lakes for this round; not a smoothed series.

data_files.format: UTF-8 CSV; header; decimal point; no row index

track.meaning: Calendar lane name; US development, common-source fitting, or target evaluation.

start_date.meaning: Inclusive beginning of the calendar strip.

end_date_exclusive.meaning: Exclusive end of the calendar strip, e.g. 2026-01-01 includes all of 2025.

observation_system.meaning: Observation system attached to this evaluation set, not an inferred cause of the result.

data_files.purpose: Panel a continental-US country outline; public-domain Natural Earth base geometry.
data_files.format: GeoJSON FeatureCollection, WGS84 EPSG:4326, longitude/latitude coordinate order
data_files.geometry: Real Natural Earth 1:110m geometry, clipped to continental-US extent; not research measurements.

data_files.purpose: Panel a state polygons, 48 contiguous states and District of Columbia; use fine boundary strokes.
data_files.format: GeoJSON FeatureCollection, WGS84 EPSG:4326, longitude/latitude coordinate order
data_files.geometry: Real Natural Earth 1:110m geometry, clipped to continental-US extent; not research measurements.

missing_values: Empty first_lead_days means no selection within 1–60 days and stays in the 681-event cohort. Empty schematic fields mean no illustrative observation. Other plotted empirical values are complete.

panels.a: Study lake geography with terrain and independently calibrated enlargements.
panels.b: All 78 observed workload rounds and separate quota reference.
panels.c: Event credit under repeated opportunities on a linear lead-time axis.
